note: Relationships the map itself cannot express. Victoria II's province history says who owns what; it does not say that Congress Poland is a Russian constituent kingdom rather than a Russian province, or that Egypt is an Ottoman vassal rather than a rival. Every entry merges onto a nation the map build already produced.

nations.name: Kingdom of Poland
nations.eraSummary: Congress Poland still has its own sejm, army and constitution. The November Uprising is ten months away.
Muhammad Ali rules Egypt as an Ottoman viceroy in name and an independent power in fact. Syria is next.
The hatt-i sharif of 1830 confirms Serbian autonomy under Ottoman suzerainty.
The Regency of Algiers answers to Constantinople only nominally. A French fleet is already being fitted out.
The Husainid beys govern Tunis as hereditary Ottoman vassals.
Karamanli Tripoli is in its last years of autonomy before direct Ottoman rule returns.
The London Protocol of February 1830 makes Greek independence a fact of European law.
The Nizam keeps his throne and his court, and the Company keeps a subsidiary army in Hyderabad.
Lhasa governs itself under the watch of the Qing ambans.
The Mongol banners are administered directly from Peking.
Xinjiang is held by Qing garrisons and an uneasy peace with the Khojas.
A southern Chinese province governed from Peking.
Yunnan's frontier prefectures sit at the edge of Qing authority.
